master.name: Alex Chen
master.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
master.summary: Software engineer with five years of experience building web applications, internal tools, and API services. Strong in TypeScript, React, and Node.js, with growing backend ownership (PostgreSQL, REST, Docker, CI/CD). Computer Science graduate focused on shipping reliable product features in small agile teams.

bullets.text: Backend services: Built and maintained NestJS REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL, including auth, billing webhooks, and admin reporting endpoints used by 40+ B2B customers.
Architecture: Split a monolithic Node service into three deployable modules with shared observability (structured logs, health checks), reducing release risk for weekly deploys.
Product UI: Delivered React dashboards for customer onboarding and usage analytics, working closely with design on accessible forms and table-heavy admin views.
Developer tooling: Added GitHub Actions pipelines (lint, test, Docker build) and a seed script that cut local environment setup from hours to minutes for new hires.
Quality: Wrote Jest unit and integration tests for API handlers and maintained staging smoke checks before production releases.
Delivery: Shipped customer-facing fixes and small features with code review, migration notes, and rollback plans discussed in sprint planning.
Internship: Implemented Python scripts to clean and aggregate CSV exports, then exposed summary metrics through a small Flask API consumed by a React chart page.

projects.title: TaskFlow API | Side project
projects.description: Personal NestJS + PostgreSQL task API with JWT auth, pagination, and OpenAPI docs; deployed on a single Docker Compose stack for learning service boundaries.

projects.title: Budget Buddy | Mobile
projects.description: React Native expense tracker with offline-first local storage and monthly category charts; published as an open-source demo app.
